h1: Custom Mesh Workwear for Safety & Comfort
metaDescription: Order custom mesh workwear for high-visibility jobs. Breathable, durable, and perfect for branding. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Mesh workwear keeps your team cool and visible in warm environments. Unlike solid fabrics, mesh allows airflow while meeting ANSI safety standards for high-visibility apparel. Whether you need Class 2 vests for road crews or UPF-rated shirts for outdoor teams, mesh construction combines breathability with durability. Decorate with your logo using screen printing or embroidery for a professional look that lasts.
heroAltText: Custom mesh workwear with high-visibility safety vest featuring reflective stripes and breathable mesh fabric
